## Change and reason

Describe the behavior, affected components and relevant issue.

## Verification

- [ ] Unit tests, lint and applicable regression tests pass.
- [ ] State whether testing used the full Home SDK or SDK-free verification build.
- [ ] KDoc, architecture/setup/privacy docs and changelog match the change.
- [ ] No credentials, private identifiers, phone exports, SDK archives or signing inputs included.
- [ ] Sampling cadence, cancellation, null/unit contracts and read-only scope are preserved.
- [ ] Screenshots/logs were reviewed for personal data, if included.

List checks not run and remaining device/account validation. Do not hide gaps behind a passing CI result.
